text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's almost summer! Before Taiki<n>leaves for
France, I make her<n>promise that she'll absolutely
win!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We can't lose to her, though! I'm<n>going to hone my
speed this summer<n>so I can surpass her!
